title: Senior Python Backend Engineer
description: We are hiring a Senior Python Backend Engineer to build high-throughput services with FastAPI and PostgreSQL. You will design REST APIs, work with Redis and Docker, and deploy to AWS. Experience with Celery and Kubernetes is a strong plus. 5+ years of experience required.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Join our ML team to build NLP and deep learning pipelines using PyTorch, TensorFlow and scikit-learn. You will work with Python, Pandas and NumPy, and deploy models on GCP. Familiarity with machine learning ops and Docker expected. 3+ years experience.

title: Frontend Developer (React)
description: Build modern UIs with React, TypeScript and Next.js. You will consume REST and GraphQL APIs and collaborate with designers. Knowledge of JavaScript testing and CI/CD is valued. 2+ years experience.

title: Data Engineer
description: Design data pipelines with Python, Spark and Airflow. Work with PostgreSQL, Snowflake and Kafka to power analytics. ETL, data engineering and AWS experience required. 4+ years experience.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Own our infrastructure with Kubernetes, Terraform and Docker on Azure. Build CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins. Strong Bash and Python scripting. Experience with Prometheus monitoring is a plus. 5+ years experience.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Work across the stack with Node.js, Express, React and MongoDB. Build REST APIs and deploy with Docker to AWS. TypeScript and PostgreSQL experience welcome. 3+ years experience.

title: Junior Data Analyst
description: Analyse product data with Python, Pandas and SQL. Build dashboards and reports. Exposure to machine learning and statistics is a plus. Entry-level, 1+ year experience.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Platform
description: Lead platform engineering with Go, Python and Kubernetes. Design microservices and gRPC APIs on GCP. Mentor engineers and drive architecture. 8+ years experience required.
